title: SB 20 (2013-2014 (130th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 20: Election Law-revise
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) and provide proof of the elector's identity in the form of a current and valid photo identification, a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of an election mailed by a board of elections under section 3501.19 of the Revised Code or a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and current address of the elector.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 3505.18(A)(3)
(quote) the elector may provide the elector's driver's license number or state identification card number. Upon providing the driver's license number or state identification card number, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code the envelope of which ballot shall include that driver's license number or state identification card number.
(section) 3505.18(A)(4)
(quote) the elector may execute an affirmation under penalty of election falsification that the elector cannot provide the identification required under that division or the last four digits of the elector's social security number for those reasons but that the elector is eligible to vote. Upon signing the affirmation, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) 3509.03(E)
(quote) (E) One of the following: (1) The elector's driver's license number or state identification card number; (2) The last four digits of the elector's social security number; (3) A copy of the elector's current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill
(section) 3509.05(A)
(quote) If the elector does not provide the elector's driver's license number, state identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope, the elector also shall include in the return envelope with the identification envelope a copy of the elector's current valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) 3505.20
(quote) (4) What official documentation do you possess to prove your citizenship? Please provide that documentation.
(e_other_rule)
(section) 3509.032(A)(2)(c)
(quote) The elector attests to the truth and accuracy of the information submitted in the online application under penalty of election falsification using the elector's Ohio driver's license number, the elector's Ohio identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's social security number as proof of the elector's identity.
(section) 3501.91(A)
(quote) No person acting under color of law shall deny the right of any individual to vote in any election because of an error or omission on any record or paper relating to any application, registration, or other act requisite to voting, if the error or omission is not material in determining whether the individual is qualified to vote in that election.
(other) 3501.x, 3501.40 (new): board of elections election administration plan for each even-year primary and general election
(other) 3501.50 (new): elections modernization task force
(other) 3501.302, 3501.91 (new): bulk purchase of supplies; no denial of the vote for an immaterial error or omission
(other) 3503.20, 3503.151 (new): online voter registration; database search rules for checking absentee applications
(other) 3505.05, 3505.184 (new): removal of local issues from the ballot; list of provisional voters who must give more information, public record within five days
(other) 3506.x, 3506.021, 3506.17: electronic poll books; direct-recording machine when voter leaves before casting
(other) 3509.x, 3511.x: absentee voting, in-person absentee period, online absentee application (3509.032), Secretary of State mailing of applications (3509.031), disaster-response voters (3511.012)
(other) 3513.x, 3517.x, 3599.x: primaries, party matters, election crimes (title only)
(other) Repeals 3503.29, 3506.16, 3517.016, 3599.111
(other) note: Only one version (introduced), a very long omnibus bill. Struck words are not marked in this PDF text and the ID text in 3505.18, 3509.03 and 3509.05 is reprinted with possible changes. Compared with the 2015 marked bill HB 189's description of the existing 2015 law, the words 'driver's license number' and 'state identification card number' as options in 3505.18(A)(3) and the 3509.05 sentence look like additions; this cannot be confirmed from the unmarked text. The citizenship line is a question that precinct officials put to a person challenged as not a citizen (3505.20); it appears to be existing law (a later 2020 bill, HB 560, strikes the same question), and the text does not show whether SB 20 changes it. 3503.14 and 3505.181-.183 also reprint ID text, and the reprinted provisional ballot affirmation form lists ID options.
